ActivityFilter.title: ActivityFilter
ActivityFilter.description: Keep (or exclude) events of the given activities.

AggregatedAttribute.title: AggregatedAttribute
AggregatedAttribute.description: An attribute summarized across every entity type that carries it.

E2OCountFilter.title: E2OCountFilter
E2OCountFilter.description: Keep events/objects by how many E2O relations of a given kind they have.

EventAttributeFilter.title: EventAttributeFilter
EventAttributeFilter.description: Keep events whose attribute matches; activities without it are untouched.

O2OCountFilter.title: O2OCountFilter
O2OCountFilter.description: Keep objects by how many O2O relations of a given kind they have.

ObjectAttributeFilter.title: ObjectAttributeFilter
ObjectAttributeFilter.description: Keep objects whose (static) attribute matches; types without it are untouched.

ObjectTypeFilter.title: ObjectTypeFilter
ObjectTypeFilter.description: Keep (or exclude) objects of the given object types.

RelationCombination.title: RelationCombination
RelationCombination.description:
A distinct (source, target, qualifier) combination of a relation.

Attributes:
    source: The source object or event type.
    target: The target object or event type.
    qualifier: The relation qualifier (empty string when none applies).

RelationCountSummary.title: RelationCountSummary
RelationCountSummary.description:
Summary statistics for relationship multiplicities in O2O or E2O relations.

For each (source type, target type[, qualifier]) combination, captures how many
related items occur per source instance.

Attributes:
    qualifier: The relation qualifier (empty string when none applies).
    qualifiers: The qualifiers aggregated under a (source, target) pair. For
        aggregated rows (``with_qualifier=False``) this lists every qualifier;
        for per-qualifier rows it is the single-element list ``[qualifier]``.
    source: The source object or event type.
    target: The target object or event type.
    min_count: The minimum number of related items for any source instance.
    max_count: The maximum number of related items for any source instance.
    sum: The total number of relation occurrences across all instances.

TimeFrameFilter.title: TimeFrameFilter
TimeFrameFilter.description: Keep (or exclude) events whose timestamp falls in ``[start, end]``.

TypedAttribute.title: TypedAttribute
TypedAttribute.description: An attribute summarized for a single entity type (activity / object type).
